title: 第7章 突然升级
slug: 班级地铁求生全班就我一个男生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一道只有姜瑶能看见的淡金色文字，在她眼前展开。

【特殊任务：与绑定对象（秦守）完成一次嘴唇接触（接触时长十秒以上）】

【任务奖励：绑定对象（秦守）“初始者”天赋进化——“自动售货机标准物资包”将纳入每日零点刷新列表。】

【任务时限：1小时。】

【失败惩罚：任务永久关闭，本车次将失去稳定食物来源。】

淡金色的文字缓缓消散。

车厢里没有人知道发生了什么。

秦守靠在自动售货机后方，勉强遮住身体。

姜瑶站在原地一动不动。

她的瞳孔微微放大了一瞬，然后急速收缩。

系统发布的特殊任务要求是——嘴唇接触！

那不就是接吻。

还必须十秒以上。

太羞耻了呀！

美女班长的耳尖以肉眼可见的速度红了。

她站在那里，脊背挺得笔直，但她的手指攥紧了矿泉水瓶，瓶身被她捏得发出一声轻微的哀鸣。

“班长？”陆小小注意到了她的异样，“你怎么了？脸好红。”

“……没事。”姜瑶的声音微微颤抖。

她松开矿泉水瓶，把手垂在身侧，攥成拳，指甲陷进掌心。

她的目光扫过秦守。

秦守正抬起头，困惑地看着姜瑶。

四目相对。

姜瑶深吸了一口气。

她是班长，她必须对所有人的生命安全负责。

现在有一个稳定获得物资的机会摆在面前，不能错过，哪怕——她因此要付出“牺牲”。

美女班长的眼神重新坚定起来。

她已经下定决心。

“秦守……”

秦守疑惑地看她。“嗯？”

姜瑶迈了一步。

额头冒汗，手心微微发抖。

刚才好不容易鼓起的勇气，此刻正在飞速消散。

她真的要当着所有人的面，和秦守来一场酣畅淋漓的亲吻吗？

太羞耻了呀！

姜瑶的脚步慢了下来。

一向果敢坚毅的美女班长，人生第一次犹豫不决。

就在这一瞬，竟有人动了。

林雪儿从车窗边走了过来。

她的动作不快，和平时一样安静。

林雪儿长发拢在身前，遮住了比基尼上缘那一小片皮肤。

还是那么文静，那么美。

她走到秦守面前，站定。

众人的目光纷纷汇聚过来。

大家疑惑地看着林雪儿，不明白她想干什么。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A pale golden text that only Jiang Yao could see unfolded before her eyes.

[Special mission: Complete a lip contact with the bound object (Qin Shou) (the contact lasts for more than ten seconds)]

[Task reward: Binding object (Qin Shou) "Beginner" talent evolution - "Vending machine standard material package" will be included in the daily refresh list at zero o'clock.】

[Task time limit: 1 hour.】

[Penalty for failure: The mission is permanently closed, and this train will lose its stable food source.】

The pale golden text slowly dissipated.

No one in the carriage knew what happened.

Qin Shou leaned behind the vending machine, barely covering his body.

Jiang Yao stood motionless.

Her pupils dilated slightly for a moment, then contracted rapidly.

The special task requirement issued by the system is-lip contact!

That's just kissing.

It must be more than ten seconds.

What a shame!

The tips of the beautiful monitor's ears turned red at a speed that was visible to the naked eye.

She stood there with her back straight, but her fingers clenched the mineral water bottle tightly, causing her to let out a slight whine when she squeezed the bottle.

"Monitor?" Lu Xiaoxiao noticed something strange about her, "What's wrong with you? Your face is so red."

"...It's okay." Jiang Yao's voice trembled slightly.

She let go of the mineral water bottle, dropped her hands to her sides, clenched them into fists, and dug her nails into her palms.

Her eyes swept over Qin Shou.

Qin Shouzheng raised his head and looked at Jiang Yao in confusion.

Eyes facing each other.

Jiang Yao took a deep breath.

She is the squad leader and she must be responsible for everyone's safety.

Now there was an opportunity to obtain stable supplies before her, and she couldn't miss it, even if she had to pay a "sacrifice" for it.

The beautiful monitor's eyes became firm again.

She had made up her mind.

"Qin Shou..."

Qin Shou looked at her doubtfully."Huh?"

Jiang Yao took a step.

His forehead was sweating and his palms were shaking slightly.

The courage that I finally mustered up just now is quickly dissipating at this moment.

Does she really want to have a hearty kiss with Qin Shou in front of everyone?

What a shame!

Jiang Yao's pace slowed down.

The beautiful squad leader, who has always been bold and resolute, was hesitant for the first time in her life.

At this moment, someone moved.

Lin Xueer walked over from the car window.

She didn't move quickly and was as quiet as usual.

Lin Xueer's long hair was gathered in front of her body, covering the small piece of skin on the top edge of her bikini.

Still so quiet and beautiful.

She walked to Qin Shou and stood still.

Everyone's eyes converged on him.

Everyone looked at Lin Xueer in confusion, not understanding what she wanted to do.
